evaluation_plan.purpose: Fresh frozen-source evaluation after development; target approximately 90 percent across the complete declared matrix.
evaluation_plan.physics: Unchanged contacts, robot, object properties, and strict five-second / 3 mm evaluator.
evaluation_plan.reporting: Report every group and the overall 100-trial denominator, including controlled stops and tall/unreachable failures. No frozen result used for source tuning.
evaluation_plan.limits: Upright initial objects, zero initial yaw. Triangular targets remain unsupported and excluded by the existing random sampler; triangles may occur as distractors.

protocol: One candidate was frozen before these reserved trials. Every declared case is retained; no source changes or adaptive exclusions were made for this evaluation.
runtime_boundary: CPU policy receives calibrated side RGB-D, wrist RGB, robot proprioception and robot-only IK previews, plus the public symbolic goal. It never receives simulator object poses, dimensions, contacts or evaluator results.
offline_evaluation_boundary: Per-trial private final stability checks below are recorded only after policy execution for offline scoring. They are not policy inputs. No images or simulator trajectory states are included.
success_definition: Complete ordered tower satisfying the unchanged private contact, support-margin, uprightness, velocity and five-second stability check, including the 3 mm drift threshold. Partial placement scores and visual completion notes do not count as success.
verification: All manifests match the predeclared100-case plan, heldout split, sensor profile and exact frozen source hash. Every result passes evaluate_columns.validate_column_result; cached summaries, goals, identities, sensors, counts, outcomes and final checks are cross-checked.
cpu_timing_scope: Worker policy CPU includes compile/import/run and excludes RPC serialization, simulator/rendering and host robot IK. Host IK CPU is separate. Quantiles summarize per-trial CPU totals; the distribution of within-trial p95 values is not a pooled per-call p95. Simulation seconds are not wall-clock latency.

statistical_limits: The Wilson95 interval assumes independent Bernoulli trials and is only a descriptive heuristic here. Seeds recur across recipe/distractor cells, outcomes are correlated, and the declared fixed distribution is not all possible towers. Report subgroup counts alongside the overall100-case denominator.
coverage_limits: Upright initial objects, zero initial yaw. Triangular targets remain unsupported and excluded by the existing random sampler; triangles may occur as distractors.
